text:
Butterfly, flower of air,

combs the area of the rose.

Everything is like that, butterfly,

when one lives in the air.

And the hours of air are

those of the voices that fly.

Only in the voices that fly

does the heart carry wings.

Carry them away from here, for they are

the only voices that fly.

translation.title: Butterfly, Flower of Air...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the airy circularity of butterfly, rose, voice, and heart.
